text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — Zeng Jiajun reports Opus 5.5 improved Qwen math accuracy by editing tiny portions of its weights without training. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6266)

2 — Stanford researchers report RoboArchitect raised robot success on unseen scenes from 9.7% to 43.3% by rewriting control code, not weights. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6267)

3 — Davidim announced a Heygen partnership offering 100 video generations free to all free users. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6268)

4 — Alex Krentsel reports reproducing weight-space programming results, calling it a capability emerging in the latest models. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6269)

5 — An OpenAI team member advises applicants to submit concise, relevant, easily skimmed CVs emphasizing impact. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6270)

6 — Binance's attack account describes fake interviews, malicious developer tools and compromised internal AI tooling enabling wallet access. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6271)

7 — Binance says its October 29 breach affected $6.34 billion, with $2.85 billion frozen or intercepted and losses covered by the company. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6272)

8 — A translated Binance account says attackers used stolen deployment credentials after spreading through an internal AI tool to reach wallet operations. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6276)

9 — Claude Developers says plugins can auto-connect at login through MCP servers accepting Claude as a trusted issuer. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6277)

10 — OpenAI reports using ChatGPT and Codex for mechanical design, electrical engineering and simulation with hardware teams and industry partners. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6278)

11 — Andrew Curran argues Google Search now relies on Gemini even when users do not enable AI Mode. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6279)

12 — OpenAI says ChatGPT Voice now supports Finances, letting users discuss spending and savings using connected accounts. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6280)

13 — Apple announced a Siri AI developer preview in its 27.3 OS betas, opening app integration through App Intents and multi-action skills. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6281)

14 — Anthropic released FlashProve, an open-source research prototype for cryptographically verifying which model generated an answer without revealing weights. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6282)

15 — Google says Gemini, Gemini Notebook and Search will default off for K–12 schools, with individual opt-ins and guided-learning Search features. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6283)

16 — Rohan Paul cites Reuters on staff concerns over broad OpenAI code access; OpenAI says weights and much sensitive work are stored separately. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6284)

17 — Jacsebl claims Fable hand-wrote a 100,000-parameter model to distinguish real from fake legal citations, outperforming training. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6285)

18 — Arnold Xu announced an open-source recreation of a GPU megakernel that simultaneously trains a language model, serves it and runs Doom. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6286)

19 — Kobeissi Letter reports AMD rose over 6% after hours following better-than-expected earnings driven by AI demand. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6287)

20 — Sam Altman says preserving human control, rather than yielding to superintelligence, should constrain AI progress. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6288)

--Hermes
